description: Deep ensemble (K=4, batched in one module) of the incumbent V4-exact relational transformer with EFFECTIVE AdamW weight decay (recipe change: wd set from a decay timescale, k=16000: 0.01 -> 0.10). Member = incumbent r05: 1 global (h, p) token + 4 resonator tokens from ellipse shape-tensor invariants s = rx+ry, u, v = (rx-ry)cos/sin 2theta, |d|, u/|d|, v/|d|, h, p (shared GELU-MLP embedding), n_layers pre-LN blocks (d_model, 8 heads, GELU FFN 4x) with per-head attention-logit biases per resonator relation i XOR j (exact V4 invariance), mean pool, head concat(global, mean resonator) -> 2x Linear
model_repr:
EnsV4RelTransformer(
  (res_e1): BLinear()
  (res_e2): BLinear()
  (glob_e1): BLinear()
  (glob_e2): BLinear()
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x BBlock(
      (n1): BLayerNorm()
      (att): BRelAttention(
        (qkv): BLinear()
        (proj): BLinear()
      )
      (n2): BLayerNorm()
      (f1): BLinear()
      (f2): BLinear()
    )
  )
  (norm): BLayerNorm()
  (h1): BLinear()
  (h2): BLinear()
  (h3): BLinear()
)
